_comment: 走力T90モデルの係数置き場。未較正モデルは enabled=false か status=UNCALIBRATED のままにし、値を推測で埋めない。T90=最初の走行ステップから90ftを直線移動する時間。NPB+公式名称はSprint Speed。旧top_speed名は互換aliasとしてのみ残す。

target.name: t90_sec
target.definition: 最初の走行ステップから90ftを直線移動する身体的スプリント時間
target.rating_mapping: NPB reference empirical CDF -> normal score -> 50 + 15z

mlb_sprint_t30_to_t90.evidence: 2022 NPB-connected n=26 sanity check: R2=0.9810, leave-one-out MAE=0.0212s. Coefficients from that limited sample are deliberately not frozen here.

mlb_sprint_t10_to_t90.evidence: 2022 NPB-connected n=26 sanity check: R2=0.9675, leave-one-out MAE=0.0286s.

mlb_sprint_to_t90.evidence: 2022 NPB-connected n=26 sanity check: r=-0.9662, R2=0.9336, leave-one-out MAE=0.0387s.

npb_sprint_speed_acceleration_to_t90.metric: NPB+ Sprint Speed / スプリントスピード
npb_sprint_speed_acceleration_to_t90.reason: NPB+ publishes Sprint Speed / fastest home-to-first from Hawk-Eye, but official public material does not disclose a formula equivalent to MLB Statcast Sprint Speed. Do not assume metric equivalence from common Hawk-Eye infrastructure or identical naming.
npb_sprint_speed_acceleration_to_t90.required_next_gate: NPB clean acceleration/T30 or trajectory-derived T90 training data

npb_sprint_speed_to_t90.metric: NPB+ Sprint Speed / スプリントスピード
npb_sprint_speed_to_t90.reason: Official NPB+ naming is Sprint Speed, but its public formula/window/aggregation has not been verified equivalent to MLB Statcast Sprint Speed. Existing same-player cross-system overlap is insufficient to identify a robust NPB+→T90 regression. Unit conversion alone is prohibited.
npb_sprint_speed_to_t90.required_next_gate: More same-player direct overlap or direct NPB T90 labels

npb_top_speed_acceleration_to_t90.reason: Compatibility name only. NPB+ official metric name is Sprint Speed.

npb_top_speed_to_t90.reason: Compatibility name only. NPB+ official metric name is Sprint Speed.

hp1b_avg_to_t90.reason: Season-average home-to-first is repeatable but still mixes swing-to-run transition and batting-side context. Use only after condition/batting-side calibration. Fastest home-to-first is never accepted.

sprint50_to_t90.note: 50m is a prior, not a direct definition of baseball speed. Fukumoto QA prohibits using 50m ranking as a hard cap.

proxy.note: Tier E fallback only. UBR / extra advance / steals / triples are intentionally excluded from base speed.

qa: Fukumoto: 50m/yoidon ranking alone cannot disqualify S; 106 steals cannot create S.
Safety bunt: normal-swing and bunt home-to-first times must not be pooled.
Sprint Speed vs acceleration: same Sprint Speed can have materially different T90.
NPB+ and MLB both use the name Sprint Speed, but public formula equivalence is not established.
Suzuki Seiya 2022: T90=3.96s should represent above-average but non-elite speed in 2022 MLB reference distribution.
